title: Spare capacity is not reachable reserve
text: Tip 1e7cd09 on research/uqcf-overlapping-guard-exchange, 10 Oct 2026, not on the integration branch and not on main. The index records scoped C3 closeouts. Static capacity is exact for maximal original footprints in the stated domain: a safe core with s labels absent exists exactly when kappa is at most the palette size minus s. That is feasibility, not connectivity. One saturated family is an antichain with no safe first toggle, while for n at least 3 a safe target still leaves n-2 labels absent. A later family is not isolated: safe edits exist, and the uniformly safe single-toggle component still has exactly seven cores. For n at least 3 those spare labels stay unreachable. So kappa below the palette size, plus unrelated local progress, is not a sufficient transferable-reserve criterion. It is not a general impossibility theorem. The words universal core region mean a candidate that is admissible for every original protected hidden completion in the declared tau 3 to 4 domain. They do not give observer access or general connectivity. Saturated transfer works for two or more private blocks in its family and fails for one. Strict nesting can give a first safe edit and still not free a label. Archived Gemini reviews accepted these scoped writeups. That acceptance is not peer review, not numbered v16 certification, and not a physical claim. Broad C3, general C4, native observer origin, outcome selection, and guaranteed progress stay open. The named next task is a restoring path that releases one prescribed occupied label while keeping donor-footprint containment, floors, and an upper-four cover. Main STATUS.md is unchanged. Issue #104 is not reopened. No A12.6.

title: v16.50 repeats a binary repair without raising the total excursion
text: PR #98 merged as 4a28661 into research/v16.34-fiber-component-invariant on 1 Oct 2026, not into main. CLOSED/CERTIFIED for finite full binary trees. Full binary means every internal vertex has exactly two children. It does not mean balanced or uniform depth. A repaired child supplies a fixed-root repair, a compact canonical endpoint, and label-role exchanges that preserve its interior. Joining two such children preserves those properties in the parent, so the argument repeats through any finite binary tree without raising the excursion bound. The bound is the total over all vertices: the sum of absolute profile deviations is at most 1. A one-unit difference at one binary vertex is not the result. There the hitting number is only 1 or 2. The construction keeps separate deviations from coexisting. This is an existence theorem for a suitable sequence. It does not say every sequence stays inside the bound, that the sequence is short, or that one evolution is selected. The minimum palette width is necessary and sufficient. If the children need widths a and b, the parent needs max(a,b) when its hitting number is 1, and a+b when it is 2. Overlap reuses labels. Disjoint children reserve separate labels. Those resources can grow while the peak profile departure stays 1. The uniform barrier is one property of a structure whose feasibility requirements stay nontrivial. It is not merely a uniform tax. The 1920 directed specification cases, 72512 primitive moves, and 994 checks support the implementation. They are not an exhaustive enumeration of every state. The general quantifiers rest on the induction. All 36 scientific files matched byte-for-byte at the merge. The science-branch REPORT.md still contains an earlier sentence that receipt closeout remained required. That sentence is not the later closeout. Higher arity stays unresolved.
